title: About the Partner Center Console
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-09
html:
Welcome to the TikTok Shop Partner Center Console end user documentation! The Partner Center Console is the web application used by TikTok Shop Partners of all types to create and manage the services they offer to sellers and creators, and streamline daily operations. The TikTok Shop Partner Center Console simplifies collaboration processes and offers valuable insights into your business. If you're just getting started and haven't yet determined which type of TikTok Service Partner you are or you haven't yet onboarded, please start by learning more about TikTok Shop Service Partner types.

Next steps

If you're ready to get started or are an established TikTok Shop Partner, you can learn more about TikTok Shop Partner Center Console functionality in the guides specific to your partner type.
